* '''Playtest''' ([[Lady Proxima (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-ladyproxima-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/ladyproxima.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “Lost if at an exterior site. While with two of your other aliens, adds one battle destiny. During your control phase, may reveal the top three cards of your Reserve Deck, take one alien into hand (if possible), and shuffle your Reserve Deck.”
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-ladyproxima-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/ladyproxima.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “Lost if at an exterior site. While with two of your other aliens, adds one battle destiny. During your control phase, may reveal the top three cards of your Reserve Deck, take one alien into hand (if possible), and shuffle your Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
